responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduler model for tuning RISC-V code generation to the MIPS P8700 microarchitecture. It declares the automata, execution units, and instruction reservations for the core’s address-generation, ALU, multiply/divide, and floating-point pipelines, assigning latencies and resource usage to scalar, floating-point, branch, load/store, and selected extension instruction types under `tune="mips_p8700"`; unmapped RVV and other unsupported classes are intentionally routed to dummy reservations, making this file a processor-specific scheduling description rather than an instruction-selection source.
